notes: Contraction of technology-replace-0015. That revision's edit is derived (the largest hydroelectric power station on the Yangtze, from three premises), so this removes its main stored premise: 'The Three Gorges Dam stands on the Yangtze' (stands_on_river, functional; the other premise, that the dam is the world's largest hydroelectric power station, stays). Cardinality question: the Yellow River, another Chinese river ('no' before, because a dam stands on one river; 'does not know' after). Related near reads the premise from the river's side (the staged relation has_dam is the inverse of stands_on_river, used through `via`); related far reaches the river by its Chinese name Chang Jiang (binding). Derived: two compositions that look up a fact stored about the Yangtze by name (its sea and Wuhan), through the removed fact. The revision's Hoover Dam, Colorado River, largest-station and longest-river questions describe the new value or the derived edit and are not reused. Counts to run are in count_requests.
